input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred T4C position. Section 9.4 gives us an unconditional right to terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause, and Section 29.4 fixes that notice period at "thirty days before the effective termination date" — i.e. no more than 30 days' written notice. On such termination we owe "only accrued Fees" (no early-termination fee or penalty anywhere in the document, and Section 10.2 repeats the refund obligation), and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, which is a pro-rata refund. Vendor has no convenience right during the committed term: its only termination rights are for our uncured material breach (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and, under the IP indemnity, termination of the infringing item with a refund (20.x, which expressly bars termination of unaffected Services). Renewal non-renewal notice under Section 8.2 is a Customer-only right and is a RENEWAL matter, not a Vendor mid-term convenience right. No redline required.
